race.description: Taylor's Palace Hotel After The Last Hcp (56)
race.comment: Pretty open. JUST LIKE LISA (5) has been close to a win and gets chance. Just missed racing on speed two back then was a close-up third in heavy ground last time behind SHOOTING FOR STARS. Meets the winner 2kg better and can turn the tables. SHOOTING FOR STARS (6) looks the danger again. Going pretty well and broke through for an overdue win latest over the border. Up in weight and tricky gate but going better than most and is worth following up. RAGING MONKEY (3) has the ability and will give a sight this easier grade. MAGIC FIELD (1) is better than recent form and looks well placed here. Can improve. SIMPLY LUSCIOUS (9) is a speedy mare well placed with the claim and will give a sight.
